_comment_sd_bands: SD bands = current VWAP +/- multiplier * rolling stdev of (Close - VWAP) over sd_period main-interval candles. All three levels float with VWAP/SD for as long as a trade is open.
_comment_reentry_sd_threshold: After a stop-out (SL), a direction won't re-arm for a new entry until price has pulled back to within this many SD of VWAP -- prevents immediate re-entry while still beyond the band during a non-reverting move. Does not apply after a winning target-exit close.
_comment_live_trading_enabled: Master safety switch. Must be explicitly set to true for LIVE mode to place any real order. false (default) keeps LIVE fully paper-trade.
_comment_target_exit: Which of Exit1(1SD)/Exit2(VWAP) ALSO closes the real position for real, in addition to SL (SL is always a real exit regardless of this setting). One of: null, "exit1", "exit2". null means SL is the only real exit.
